inventory.notes: -moz-element painting takes the as-drawn path, so the element is shown without canvas noise, like on screen. Category spoof because what it renders is what a page sees.

Not spoof: GetSurfaceSnapshot applies CanvasUtils::StealthProjectSnapshot noise for WebGL/WebGPU contexts (dom/canvas/OffscreenCanvasDisplayHelper.cpp:459-478) and GetSurfaceSnapshotAsDrawn (line 481) skips it, so the drag image / taskbar preview show the real pixels; a page cannot read either. Companion of the canvas-noise feature, no page-visible effect.

verifier.why: Read GetSurfaceSnapshotAsDrawn: it returns the image without the stealth canvas noise that GetSurfaceSnapshot applies, so the change keeps host UI unnoised and is not page-observable; category stays other.
